title: Implement DHT-based tip discovery fallback
description:
Implement DHT tip storage: when a transit node appends to a group log, it puts the current tip CID into the DHT under key derived from the group name. Implement find_tips_via_dht(group_name: &str) -> Vec<Cid>: query DHT for the group key and return all tip CIDs found. Used by nodes that have been offline and cannot rely on gossipsub. Artifact: transit/src/gossip/dht_tips.rs.

Acceptance criteria:
- dht_key_for_group(group_name) produces a stable, deterministic key
- put_tip and get_tip round-trip correctly in a two-node test
- find_tips_via_dht returns empty vec gracefully if DHT has no entry (not an error)
- Integration test: node A puts tip, node B (no gossipsub connection) finds it via DHT
